{"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-abrj","title":"rust/lichen-schc/src/context.rs: Bit shift overflow when mo_arg is 0 on 128-bit fields","description":"When mo_arg=0 and length_bits=128 (e.g., IPv6 address fields), the shift amount equals 128. Shifting u128 by 128 bits causes a panic in debug builds or wraps to shift-by-0 in release builds, comparing full values instead of matching zero bits. The guard at line 184 only checks mo_arg > length_bits, not whether the resulting shift exceeds the value's bit width.

Fix suggestion: Add a check before the shift: if shift >= 128, the comparison should trivially succeed (all bits shifted out means equality). For example: `if shift >= 128 { /* MSB of 0 bits always matches */ } else if (val >> shift) != (fd.target_value >> shift) { return false; }`
